name: GRANT-SLEEP-never-due
old:
export const grantMeasureDue = (w, nowMs) =>
  (w.rows.size > 0 || w.tallies.size > 0) && nowMs - w.from >= GRANT_MEASURE_MS;
new: export const grantMeasureDue = (w, nowMs) => (w.rows.size > 0 || w.tallies.size > 0) && nowMs - w.from >= Infinity;
note: a window that is never owed its post

name: GRANT-SLEEP-due-at-once
old:
export const grantMeasureDue = (w, nowMs) =>
  (w.rows.size > 0 || w.tallies.size > 0) && nowMs - w.from >= GRANT_MEASURE_MS;
new: export const grantMeasureDue = (w, nowMs) => (w.rows.size > 0 || w.tallies.size > 0) && nowMs - w.from >= 0;

name: GRANT-SLEEP-the-timer-back
new:
if (full || grantMeasureDue(G.w, now)) void this._grantFlush();
    else setTimeout(() => { void this._grantFlush(); }, 600_000);
